name: Prefix Sum Array
description: Builds a prefix sum array where prefix[i] = sum of arr[0..i]. Enables O(1) range sum queries after O(n) preprocessing.
aim: Precompute cumulative sums so any range [l,r] sum can be answered in O(1): rangeSum = prefix[r] - prefix[l-1].
howItWorks: prefix[i] = prefix[i-1] + arr[i] for i from 1 to n-1
Build once, answer any range query in O(1)

complexity.spaceDescription: Prefix sum array of same size as input

whenToUse: Multiple range sum queries on same array
When building O(n) for O(1) queries is worthwhile
alternatives: Segment tree — O(log n) build+query, handles updates
Fenwick tree — O(log n) updates + queries
